_comment: Server-side price registry (docs/SYSTEM_DESIGN.md 6.4). Edit this file to change rates; it is read by the Node backend only and is never writable through the API. Rates are USD. Null/absent rate = cannot price (cost shows Unknown, never $0.00). Bump `revision` whenever you change a rate.

entries.unit: USD per 1M tokens (standard tier, prompts at or under 272K input tokens). Longer prompts are billed higher by the vendor and are not priced here.
USD per audio minute (vendor estimated cost)

USD per 1M tokens (standard tier, short context). IDENTIFY uses these same rates on the token counts the API returns. Image tokens are included only when the provider folds them into input_tokens; this file does not add a separate image price.
USD per audio minute (vendor 'estimated cost'; the API reports tokens but the page does not split audio/text input token rates)
USD per 1M tokens. Text input 0.60, cached text input 0.06, text output 2.40, audio input 10, cached audio input 0.30, audio output 20. This TTS path sends text only.
USD per 1M tokens (text input / audio output). The non-streaming speech endpoint returns no usage, so cost is Unknown unless usage is reported.
